scope.statement: Independently reconstruct the exact finite cut sums and boundary-versus-internal work ledger in published PR #114, then test boundary-row removal, weakened internal B support, and a separate positive-multiplier corruption.
scope.domain: One rational vector-incidence model at PR #114 head cd33f4c76fd48722f06c03ddc86a05fd5e8f9e51, with three A cuts, two B cuts, seven unit rows, positive diameter multipliers, and support tree {(0,2),(0,3),(1,2)}.
scope.limitations: No planar point realization, hull order, contact endpoints, individual contact rows, vertex-level equilibrium, complete all-pairs source ledger, global minimizer, asymptotic family, or C-II endpoint is supplied. The result audits cut-incidence scope only.

result: The exact B resultants are (-11/5,276/65) and (14/5,276/65), with determinant -276/13. The shear vector is (-1,0); internal work is -48/13 and boundary-row work is +48/13. The reference row contributes zero.
remaining_questions: Determine whether these support and payment data can be embedded in a full planar threshold source with vertex-level contact equilibrium and every required source-pair constraint.

If source geometry excludes the model, prove the exact source-specific restriction that excludes its boundary payment; if it admits it, identify the additional global argument needed beyond cut equations.
